featured_reviews.name: Kripa Gopalan
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had a wonderful experience working with The White Room for designing our new studio apartment. Their dedication towards both the design and execution was truly commendable. The team was very professional, thorough, and attentive throughout the process.

They took the time to carefully understand our requirements and translated them into a design that works beautifully for our space. The entire process was handled with great care and responsibility, and the final outcome has been done very nicely.

We sincerely appreciate their effort and would happily recommend them.

featured_reviews.name: Alpa Thosar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a truly fulfilling experience working with The White Room and their team. They designed our home with great attention to detail, thoughtfully considering the needs of both my in-laws and my young child. The space is safe, child-friendly, and senior-citizen friendly, with every small detail carefully planned.

Their sincerity, professionalism, and dedication truly reflect in their work. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a reliable interior designer and architect.

Thank you for creating a home perfectly suited to our family.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so much for your heartfelt words. It was truly a pleasure designing a home that thoughtfully caters to every generation of your family. Your appreciation for our sincerity, professionalism, and detailing means a lot to us.

featured_reviews.name: Pravin Patel
featured_reviews.review_text: Me and my team had a very good experience working with The White Room. They designed our office beautifully, with excellent space planning that perfectly accommodates all the required functionality. The design feels practical, well thought out, and aesthetically pleasing at the same time. Very happy with the overall outcome and the professionalism shown throughout the project.

featured_reviews.name: Pratibha Hinge
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a wonderful experience working with The White Room. They designed and executed my clinic project beautifully. Every single detail was thoughtfully planned and meticulously executed. The design was elegant, functional, and perfectly aligned with my vision.

What truly impressed me was their professionalism and commitment to timelines — the execution was completed exactly as promised, without any compromise on quality.

I genuinely appreciate the entire team and the owners for their dedication and hard work. I would strongly recommend The White Room to anyone looking for interior design, architecture, bungalow design, residential projects, or complete turnkey execution.

They are extremely professional, reliable, and excellent at what they do.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
We sincerely appreciate your kind words and recommendation Dr.Pratibha. 
Delivering elegant, functional spaces with quality execution and timely completion is always our priority. Thank you for trusting The White Room with your clinic project.

featured_reviews.name: triveni gosavi
featured_reviews.review_text: A wonderful collaboration with The White Room. Deepti  and Disney transformed  my sisters salon beautifully — from concept to design to final execution — with remarkable creativity and attention to detail. The entire journey was seamless, professional, and perfectly managed. The space is elegant, functional, and thoughtfully designed. Highly recommended for anyone looking for refined, high-quality design and execution.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: We are glad that our sincerity, professionalism, design, and execution were appreciated by you and your family. Our best wishes always.

featured_reviews.name: Krushi Vakharia
featured_reviews.review_text: The White Room( Deepti and Disney )has done a beautiful job designing our apartment for our family. They perfectly understood our lifestyle, preferences, and functional needs, and transformed the space into a warm, elegant, and thoughtfully planned home. The entire family is truly happy with the outcome. Their professionalism, creativity, and attention to detail made the complete journey smooth and enjoyable. We genuinely appreciate the work done by The White Room and highly recommend them.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Grateful for your kind words, Mrs Krushi. It is always rewarding to see our work valued by clients who believe in good design.

featured_reviews.name: Sachin Tambat
featured_reviews.review_text: Me and my family truly appreciate The White Room for their excellent design and execution skills. The entire experience was smooth, professional, and well-coordinated. Highly recommended.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: “Grateful for your kind words, Mr. Sachin. It is always rewarding to see our work valued by clients who believe in good design, execution, and professionalism. Our best wishes to you and your family.”
